_what: Manual starter overrides, consulted BEFORE any resolver path.
_why: 2026-10-23. Andy: 'saw jameis winston as starting qb when giant released
recently, jj mccarthy will be starting'. nfl_starters had NYG = Jameis
Winston on week 7 with source box_score_w6, and nothing in the resolver
could have known better:
* ESPN probables and leaders returned NOTHING for all 28 resolved
teams, so week 7 was 100% box-score carryover -- the exact 'a
fallback that silently handles 100% of cases is not a fallback, it
is the implementation' shape this script's own docstring warns about.
* carryover is injury-gated via nfl_injuries, and a RELEASED player is
not injured, so no gate fires.
* nfl_rosters_current, pulled the same day at 16:25Z, still lists
Winston as ACT on NYG. So a roster-status check would not have caught
it either. It DOES carry J.J. McCarthy as ACT on NYG (his MIN row is
stale: INA, last updated 09-28), which corroborates the correction.
* nfl_current_depth_chart.json, the only forward-looking source
nfl_game_context consults for _NFL_QB1_MAP, was last scraped
2026-09-14 -- 39 days stale -- and still named Jaxson Dart, who is
now RES.
A release is news before it is data. There is no feed we hold that
carried it, so a human override is the only correct mechanism, and it
has to beat the resolver or the Saturday 10am rerun writes Winston back
from the same box score.
_how: Applies when week >= from_week, and through_week if set (inclusive).
NEVER applied in --retrospective mode: that pass records who ACTUALLY
started a completed week, which is history and must not be rewritten.
Every applied override prints on every run, so a stale one is loud
rather than silent. Delete an entry once the feeds agree with it.

overrides.reason: Giants released Jameis Winston; McCarthy starting. Andy, 2026-10-23. Corroborated by nfl_rosters_current: McCarthy ACT on NYG as of 2026-10-23T16:25Z.

nfl_current_depth_chart.json names Baker Mayfield, but Jalon Daniels ACTUALLY started weeks 4, 5 and 6 (27/25/43 attempts, nfl_player_stats; nfl_starters source=box_score_actual_w4/w5/w6). Mayfield started only weeks 1-3. Both are ACT on nfl_rosters_current so roster status cannot resolve it. The depth-chart feed lags on mid-season job changes -- the same staleness Andy flagged on 2026-09-14 for the RB/WR slots (Kamara over Etienne, Mike Evans over Egbuka), now shown at QB. Needed because the scrape overwrites _NFL_QB1_MAP unconditionally.

nfl_current_depth_chart.json and the hardcoded fallback both name Lamar Jackson, but nfl_injuries has Jackson 'Out' (Ankle/Sprain) with report_date 2026-10-25 and Huntley 'Full' -- and Huntley actually started weeks 5 and 6. Both QBs are ACT on nfl_rosters_current so roster status cannot resolve it. ROOT CAUSE: the scrape overlay onto _NFL_QB1_MAP has NO injury gate, unlike the carryover path in nfl_weekly_starters. A depth chart lists the nominal starter, not the one who is available. Remove this entry once the overlay is injury-gated.
